note: Weights only. No scenario text, no scene script, no if-this-town-then-that. The engine reads these when it chooses and arranges pieces (src/english/calibration.ts); scripts/dialogue-batch/apply-grades.ts folds the owner's grades in. An empty table changes nothing.

step.checkedAgainst: How far one grade of 1 to 5 moves a weight; small so no single grade decides a piece.

pieceFloor.checkedAgainst: The lowest share of its weight a piece with a running grade of 1 keeps (it is chosen less, never banned; a ban is a failed grade in part-grades.json).

pieceCeiling.checkedAgainst: The highest multiple a piece with a running grade of 5 can reach.

pieceFullAt.checkedAgainst: Grades at which a piece's running mean counts in full; fewer count in proportion.

lengthSlope.checkedAgainst: How fast a piece loses weight as it departs from the register's target length, per fraction of the target.

pullScale.checkedAgainst: How many words of target length one unit of a trait's length pull moves, as a share of the target.

bearingScale.checkedAgainst: How much one unit of a speaker's summed trait pull toward a wording's bearing multiplies its weight; checked on the bench so a warm and a cold profile choose different wordings on most lines without any wording going unused.

bearingFloor.checkedAgainst: The least share of its weight a wording keeps when the speaker leans away from its bearing; never zero, so a trait shapes a voice and never bans a line.

conversation.source: data/english/counts/everyday.json: median turn 5 words over 24,423 turns of the Santa Barbara Corpus of Spoken American English

traitsSource: ESTIMATED: the direction of each pull follows research on personality and word use (Mehl, Gosling and Pennebaker 2006, 'Personality in its natural habitat', JPSP 90(5); Yarkoni 2010, 'Personality in 100,000 words', J. Research in Personality 44(3)): extraverted and agreeable people talk more and warmer, neurotic people hedge, disagreeable people argue. Sizes are TUNABLE, spread -1 to 1 each; the owner's trait-fit grades move them.
